claim_verdicts.evidence: git show stage-1:DonHang.Api/Middleware/RequestLoggingMiddleware.cs lines 11-23: `await next(context); stopwatch.Stop(); logger.LogInformation("{Method} {Path} responded {StatusCode} in {ElapsedMs}ms", ...)`. No try/finally, so an exception from next(context) leaves InvokeAsync before LogInformation. Lesson block matches source character-for-character.

Program.cs@stage-1:67-68: `app.UseMiddleware<ExceptionHandlingMiddleware>(); app.UseMiddleware<RequestLoggingMiddleware>();`. ExceptionHandlingMiddleware.cs: try { await next(context); } catch KeyNotFoundException -> LogWarning + 404; ArgumentException -> LogWarning + 400; Exception -> LogError(ex, "unhandled exception") + 500, then WriteProblemAsync.

docker-compose.yml@stage-1:82-99: api service has build, image donhang-api:stage-1, container_name donhang-api, hostname api, environment, depends_on, networks; no `logging:` key. No service (lab, web, db, api, app-web) mounts the Docker socket or reads container output. Lesson block lines 82-88 matches source exactly.

compose_logs.md: "Displays log output from services"; --since: "Show logs since timestamp (e.g. 2013-01-02T13:23:37Z) or relative (e.g. 42m for 42 minutes)". engine/logging/_index.md: "By default, `docker logs` shows the command's `STDOUT` and `STDERR`." engine/logging/configure.md: "The default logging driver is `json-file`."

console-log-formatter.md: "By default, the `Simple` console log formatter is selected with default configuration." Its sample default output: "info: Console.ExampleFormatters.Json.Startup[0]" followed by an indented "      Hello .NET friends!". Program.cs@stage-1 registers no other formatter; appsettings.json sets Default level Information, so category DonHang.Api.Middleware.RequestLoggingMiddleware logs at Information. `4ms` is an example value.

Executed (GNU grep 3.0) on compose-style prefixed Simple-formatter output: header lines plus indented '... responded 500 in 12ms', '... responded 200 in 5ms', '... responded 503 in 2ms' | grep -c "responded 5" -> 2. Substring match on 500 and 503, no false hit on 'responded 200 in 5ms'; header lines lack 'responded', so one count per 5xx event. compose_logs.md: --since "relative (e.g. 42m for 42 minutes)".
claim_verdicts.source: local run of grep -c; refs/docker-docs compose_logs.md

claim_verdicts.evidence: Restart condition now present in §4 and claim text. Prometheus metric types: "A counter is a cumulative metric that represents a single monotonically increasing counter whose value can only increase or be reset to zero on restart." So value-now minus value-5-min-ago is the count only without a restart in between, as the lesson states.

Prometheus data model: "Every time series is uniquely identified by its metric name and optional key-value pairs called labels." "The change of any label's value ... will create a new time series." Instrumentation: "Each labelset is an additional time series". A metric split by status code thus keeps one number per status code value seen; count of numbers follows distinct values, not traffic.

Live run 2026-09-29 on the lab (stage-2 tree; Caddy `handle /api/v1/*` → `reverse_proxy api:8080` unchanged from stage-1): `docker compose stop api`, then curl -w %{http_code} localhost:8080/api/v1/products printed 502; `docker compose logs api --since 1m` had no line for the request; api restarted, healthy.

Live run 2026-09-29 on the lab (stage-2 tree; Caddy `handle /api/v1/*` → `reverse_proxy api:8080` unchanged from stage-1): `docker compose stop api`, then curl -w %{http_code} localhost:8080/api/v1/products printed 502; `docker compose logs api --since 1m` had no line for the request; api restarted, healthy.
Restates the lesson's own definition of monitoring (continuous collection by programs); definitional, no external fact asserted beyond that.

Prometheus overview: "If you need 100% accuracy, such as for per-request billing, Prometheus is not a good choice, as the collected data will likely not be detailed and complete enough." Instrumentation: "Each labelset is an additional time series that has RAM, CPU, disk, and network costs." Supports: a metric keeps an aggregate number, not per-event detail; details come from logs.

console-log-formatter.md: "By default, the `Simple` console log formatter is selected with default configuration." Sample output: "info: Console.ExampleFormatters.Json.Startup[0]" then indented "      Hello .NET friends!"; single-line is an opt-in "compact version". console-formatter-default.md: "Starting in .NET 6.0.5, `aspnet` container images have the `Logging__Console__FormatterName` environment variable unset by default ... simple, multiline". Program.cs, appsettings.json, Dockerfile, compose @stage-1 set no formatter.
